verdict.rationale: Orb documents a Test Mode with mode-scoped API keys. In it you can create test plans, simulate workflows and send dummy data, and the docs say this isolates you from live billing data. This is a separate sandbox environment, not just a dry-run preview, and test mode has its own rate limits. Missing for 10: a dedicated Test Mode concept page detailing how data is separated and how to promote resources to live, and independent or hands-on confirmation of the isolation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: In **Test Mode**, you can create test pricing plans, simulate different workflows, and send in dummy data
To try things out without touching live billing data, create the key in **test mode**.
